project_type: npm-workspaces TypeScript monorepo: packages/shared (@dwt/shared), apps/api (Fastify + pg, Vitest + pg-mem + fast-check), apps/mobile (React Native + Expo, Jest + @testing-library/react-native)
build_system: npm workspaces. IMPORTANT: apps/api resolves @dwt/shared through packages/shared/dist (apps/api/tsconfig.json has paths:{}), so after ANY shared edit run `npm run build:shared` from the repo root before api typecheck/tests. apps/mobile maps @dwt/shared to packages/shared/src (tsconfig paths + jest moduleNameMapper) and needs no build.
test_framework: api and shared: Vitest (`npx vitest run <path>`); mobile: Jest via jest-expo (`npx jest <file>`), never Vitest for RN components; property tests use fast-check, numRuns >= 100, tagged `// Feature: photo-uploads, Property N: <text>`
build_command: npm run build:shared (needed for api); npm run typecheck (all workspaces)
test_command: inner loop: single test file + npm run typecheck; per-area: npm run verify:shared / verify:api / verify:mobile once; final: `npm run verify` ONCE from the repo root and paste the literal tail with exit code
verification_instructions: Follow .kiro/steering/execution-discipline.md: a vitest/jest run is not the gate; only `npm run verify` (tsc across workspaces + all tests) counts. Report a behavior->test map. Do not run the full gate after every edit.
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/shared/dist is gitignored build output (`npm run build:shared`). No other generated files. The pin verifiers under .kiro/specs/pin-collection do NOT apply to this task.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. Work in place at c:\Users\knick\dev\disney-app on branch develop. Do NOT create a worktree or branch, do NOT commit or push, never `git add -A` (the working tree holds many unrelated uncommitted changes: admin-panel specs, composeServices.ts, server.ts, config.ts, etc.; do not revert or reformat them). Never open or echo any .env file. No new dependencies. Edit source directly with the edit tools, never via generated scripts.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md + .kiro/steering/*: spec must be amended additively (never delete/renumber) in the same change; tests ship with the code; theme rules for mobile (makeStyles/useAppTheme, no raw colour literals, themeRetrofit.guard.test.ts must stay green); a11y roles and labels; no stray files; behavior->test map and literal `npm run verify` tail in the final report.
key_patterns: Recap route gate lives in sharing/tripRecapGate.ts (DefaultRecapShareGate, Friendship re-check before any Trip read); photo side in photos/recapPhotoPort.ts (DefaultRecapPhotoPort, serving keys via photoKeys(id), never object_key/thumb_key); PhotoService.report/addBlock take structural recapShareGate/recapPhotoPort; keyset pagination via domain/albumCursor.ts; route tests use server.inject + pg-mem (migrations 0001,0002,0013,0015,0040,0062,0063, withPgMemCompat) + FakeObjectStore (missingGetKeys); mobile tests spy on clientModule.apiRequest and render real components.
relevant_files: .agents/tasks/photo-uploads/recap-album-plan.md (THE detailed plan; read it fully first)
directory_structure: packages/shared/src/{dto,schemas,constants,__tests__}; apps/api/src/services/{sharing,photos}/{...,__tests__}; apps/api/migrations (no migration needed here); apps/mobile/src/{photos,screens/share,screens/trips,navigation}; .kiro/specs/photo-uploads/{requirements,design,tasks}.md; .agents/tasks/photo-uploads/ (artifacts, plan, review verdict).
